messages:
incident-bot: Pager -> SEV2: token-count drift detected in billing ingest (eu1). tokens_emitted vs tokens_recorded divergence > 20% over 15m. Possible duplicates/late-commit. Affected tenants receiving overage flags. https://redwood.ops/alerts/8451236789 :rotating_light:
leah: ack — I'm oncall, joining now. gathering context and starting triage.
omar: on it, tailing emitter logs + consumer group lags for eu1. preliminary view: kafka consumer lag on shard-17.
leah: @billing-sre can you surface consumer offsets + any recent restarts for shard-17 and window-agg v2?
billing-sre: digging. offsets for group `billing-emitter-eu1` partition 17 ~200k behind. consumer pod restarted ~10m ago with retry bursts. sample log: ```WARN 2026-03-20T15:12:04 emitter commit failed: OffsetOutOfRangeException partition=17```
neo: jumping in — looks like retry loop produced duplicate events that the aggregator accepted; idempotency keys not honored during partial commits.
leah: customer-impact check: @support-ops which accounts received overage notifications?
support-ops: automated system sent overage emails to acct-234 (mid-market), acct-987 (startup), acct-561 (enterprise). spikes reported ~30–50% higher tokens than our billing ledger. Pausing outbound overage emails now.
omar: hypothesis: emitter retries + consumer restart created duplicated messages; window-agg v2 currently allows non-idempotent re-ingest. reconciler counts duplicates.
leah: mitigation plan (short): 1) pause overage emails 2) increase consumer parallelism to drain backlog 3) run a targeted dedupe on last 1h aggregates 4) notify affected customers and hold charges. Who can run dedupe?
billing-sre: I can run it. command I will use: `scripts/dedupe_aggregates.sh --region eu1 --backfill 1h --window v2 --dry-run` then inspect samples before doing real run.
leah: run dry-run and paste a few sample diff lines (acct id : before -> after). keep output short.
billing-sre: dry-run output (snip):
- acct-234: ledger_count=1,482,001 -> deduped=1,009,120 (delta -47.9%)
- acct-987: ledger_count=212,320 -> deduped=142,300 (delta -33.0%)
- acct-561: ledger_count=3,210,450 -> deduped=1,642,200 (delta -48.9%)
Interpretation: dedupe would remove the anomalous excess tokens for these accounts.
support-ops: copying draft customer message: "We detected an internal processing anomaly that resulted in inflated usage emails. We're pausing notifications and will reconcile your usage; any accidental overage charges will be credited. ETA 2-4 hours." ok to send?
leah: yes, send now. also open a billing incident note in the customer portal.
neo: operational action: increased consumer replicas from 3 -> 8 for `billing-emitter-eu1`, consumer lag dropping. Triggering the real dedupe now after dry-run success: `--dry-run=false`
billing-sre: dedupe running. ETA ~18 minutes for 1h window.
omar: monitoring: `tokens_emitted - tokens_recorded` trending down; last 5m moved from +32% -> +4%. offsets for partition 17 now ~1.2k.
leah: good. blocking follow-ups: 1) crediting workflow for affected accounts 2) postmortem & root cause ticket INF-3499 (idempotency fixes to window-agg v2 + safer commit ordering) 3) add automated pause for overage emails when consumer lag > threshold.
support-ops: created support cases 9012, 9013, 9014 and informed CS; preparing one-off credits if needed.
incident-bot: Auto-update: incident state -> mitigated. See timeline https://redwood.ops/incidents/8451236789
leah: handing off to next oncall @neo for postmortem + credit ops. Leaving notes in runbook.
neo: ack, will own postmortem and INF-3499 prioritization. will follow up with affected customers and confirm credits. :thumbsup:
